one_liner: Front has a documented REST Core API with OAuth2 apps and API tokens, a free developer sandbox account, and an official vendor MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with refresh tokens; apps are created in the developer portal. Admin-created company-level API tokens are an alternative for single-company use. Partner integrations are required to use OAuth.
access_notes: Free developer account/environment with no production data, limited to 3 teammates. Admins can create API tokens under Settings > Developers.
blocker_notes: Public App Store listing requires partner approval; building and testing do not.

evidence.quote: Front's OAuth implementation only supports the authorization code grant type which defines a flow to get a temporary authorization token which can then be exchanged to get an API and refresh token.
There are two ways to get a Bearer token — through API tokens in your settings or through an OAuth implementation
You must be an admin to create or manage API tokens.
You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.
The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
Access Front data and actions through the MCP protocol, allowing AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to read and reply to conversations and other Front resources.
